description: This file is a shell script containing utility functions used within a Linux-based embedded system (OpenWrt). It includes functions for configuration management with UCI, package scripts, user and group management, device partition identification, and system initialization routines.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Outputs debug messages, defaulting to no operation if DEBUG is not set.

methods.name: config_load
methods.description: Loads configuration from UCI or returns if IPKG_INSTROOT is set.

methods.name: reset_cb
methods.description: Resets callback functions to no-ops.

methods.name: package
methods.description: Placeholder function that does nothing and returns success.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Creates a new configuration section with specified type.

methods.name: option
methods.description: Sets an option in the current configuration section.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Adds an item to a list configuration.

methods.name: config_unset
methods.description: Unsets (clears) a configuration option.

methods.name: config_get
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value with support for defaults.

methods.name: get_bool
methods.description: Converts a value to its boolean representation.

methods.name: config_get_bool
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean configuration value.

methods.name: config_set
methods.description: Sets a configuration variable.

methods.name: config_foreach
methods.description: Iterates over configuration sections of a given type.

methods.name: config_list_foreach
methods.description: Iterates over list items in a configuration section.

methods.name: default_prerm
methods.description: Executes pre-removal scripts and disables/init system services related to a package.

methods.name: add_group_and_user
methods.description: Creates system groups and users based on package dependencies.

methods.name: default_postinst
methods.description: Runs post-installation scripts for a package, including service enabling and configuration.

methods.name: include
methods.description: Includes all shell scripts from a directory.

methods.name: find_mtd_index
methods.description: Finds the MTD partition index for a given device name.

methods.name: find_mtd_part
methods.description: Retrieves the device file for an MTD partition.

methods.name: find_mmc_part
methods.description: Finds the device file for an MMC/SD card partition.

methods.name: group_add
methods.description: Adds a new system group.

methods.name: group_exists
methods.description: Checks if a group exists.

methods.name: group_add_next
methods.description: Finds the next available GID and adds a group.

methods.name: group_add_user
methods.description: Adds a user to a group.

methods.name: user_add
methods.description: Creates a new system user.

methods.name: user_exists
methods.description: Checks if a user exists.

methods.name: board_name
methods.description: Returns the board name or 'generic' if unavailable.

methods.name: cmdline_get_var
methods.description: Extracts a variable's value from /proc/cmdline.
